authorization: Continue the approved realism programme, commit/push and continue across intermediate pushes. This is a reversible development experiment using existing exposed data; no atlas adoption.
reason: The bounded plough and reaping account screens closed without matched area/work-time observations. Stop those searches. Existing city areas can test a conditional settlement relationship, but cannot substitute for observations of hours, draft stocks or population density.
amendment: Adds a distinct conditional city-extent estimand after the no-fit agricultural target closure. Does not unlock the historical operator/draft/annual-capacity calibration gate, change previous plans/receipts, or reopen reserved evidence pools.
estimand: For each fixed feature, E[log recorded city area | supplied sites and feature] = alpha + beta*x. Estimate alpha/beta by ordinary least squares on training provinces only; predictive sigma is the RMS of inner-held-out log residuals. No capital term or hierarchy in these simple models. Existing hierarchy predictions are a separate frozen reference.
input_geometry: Existing 400x600 Roman 9-km window and all1315 supplied centre cells, existing equal-tie nearest-centre hinterlands within60km. Same664 exposed area rows and original four province-hash folds. Some rows share a centre; centre aggregates are features, never summed as independent people ledgers. All known positions are supplied, including test positions.
environment: Exact restored output/urban_population_recipe_20261116/restored/grid/earth.npz. Sample wheat/barley kcal/ha and arable by the same nearest-neighbour coordinates and inside-domain rule as earth_people. Zero outside coverage; report coverage. No crop/climate rerun. No other cereals or double cropping.
workforce: Replay the fixed floodplain_settlement_base density as a reference workforce proxy. All reference people enter the work basis; no city population inferred from target area and no subtraction of area-derived residents. This is not an observed rural census. Workers=.4*reference people; fixed300/600 allocated hours per worker/year; reaping cap=min(annual,30*8 hours per worker).
grain: Choose wheat/barley by minimum listed hours per net kcal with existing cereal_work and fixed336/208 total and48/32 reaping hours/ha. Potential cropped hectares=land cell km2*100*arable*.6*.6. These are prior scenarios, not newly validated rates or planted area. Existing field_support retains complete crop activities under annual/reaping limits. Gross grain before local consumption, storage, transport and extraction; never call it exportable surplus or complete diet capacity.

features.M0: Intercept only; exactly reproduce archived benchmark baseline ensembles.
features.H_reference: log of existing floodplain_settlement_base hinterland reference people; exactly replay existing H.
features.G_potential: log1p of hinterland potential grain kcal divided by912500 kcal/ration-year.
features.G_h600: log1p of hinterland gross work-limited grain kcal divided by912500, at600h.
features.G_h300: Identical construction at300h. Retain zero grain rows with log1p; no exclusions or inferred zero labour.

protocol: Fit all664 original training rows under unchanged outer folds. Inner fits leave a second fold out; no tuning, feature selection, new hour search or all-data deployment fit. Evaluate fixed AD200-compatible, strict-basis, known-end and all664 masks from existing benchmark. Use256 paired seeds1000..1255, existing truncated-normal draws and inherited area bounds. Baseline exact control and frozen hierarchy reference come from archived benchmark; new models have no hierarchy residual swaps.
scores: Same empirical log-area CRPS, median-log-area MAE/RMSE/bias and mean generated total area/reference ratio; pooled, equal-province and per-fold, with all small provinces retained. Compare grain models with BOTH M0 and H_reference; compare work-limited grain with potential grain. Report sign/direction across folds, not a post-hoc adoption threshold.
identifiability: Report feature ranges/zeros, work-limited shares, correlation and affine log-feature residuals between300/600 cases, and their held-out mean prediction differences. A multiplicative change in gross grain can be absorbed by a free intercept. Similar predictive scores do not identify actual household hours. No hour estimate or historical capacity uncertainty interval is authorized by these area outcomes.
checks: Freeze this plan in git before constructing new features. Verify latest full protected inventory and reaping closure; pin all input/producer hashes. Independently reconstruct per-cell production from selected yield, hectares and scalar capacity minima; verify aggregate partition conservation and exact H replay. Recompute OLS/inner sigma by an independent centred scalar formula, prove held-out outcomes do not affect coefficients, exact archived M0 replay, independent CRPS formula, fresh output equivalence and visual inspection.
outputs: One report, compact feature and ensemble packets, source identities, fit and score tables, province/fold tables, identifiability diagnostics, map comparing source extent/M0/H_reference/G_h600 on supplied sites and a diagnostic plot. No source table redistribution. No map adoption regardless of result.
failure: Missing source identity, nonfinite/rank-deficient training design, broken controls or outcome-dependent features block the fit. Preserve negative grain comparisons. No automatic parameter search or broadened evidence acquisition to rescue a result.
limitations: Catalogue occupation compatibility does not date extent. Areas are heterogeneous, exposed development data; province-hash folds are not contiguous geographic blocks or new blind evidence. Known-site area prediction does not predict settlement locations/counts/populations. Annual field tasks omit draft availability and other household/processing demands. Fixed climate/population/yield assumptions remain uncalibrated here.
